title: About
intro: My career began in horticulture, where I managed gardens, high tunnels, and production systems before transitioning into software development. Working in that environment developed my ability to plan, troubleshoot, and improve complex systems — skills that continue to influence the way I approach programming.

After completing full-stack development programs focused on Java and JavaScript, I have continued building applications with Java, Spring Boot, React, and PostgreSQL. Through my projects, I have gained experience designing databases, developing REST APIs, implementing authentication, managing frontend state, and creating responsive user interfaces.

I enjoy creating software that combines strong technical foundations with thoughtful user experiences. Whether building productivity tools, business applications, or media platforms, I focus on developing applications that are practical, maintainable, and designed with the user in mind.
